args.question: What is the baggage allowance? How big can my carry-on bag be?

events.output: You are allowed to bring one bag on the plane. It must be under 50 pounds and 22 inches x 14 inches x 9 inches. If a bag is delayed or missing, file a baggage claim and we will track it for delivery.

events.text:
You are allowed to bring one bag on the plane.

It must be under 50 pounds and 22 inches x 14 inches x 9 inches.

If a bag is delayed or missing, you can file a baggage claim and we will track it for delivery.

Let me know if you need help with a baggage issue and I can connect you to the right team!
